addOnBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个组件时，是否将输入框内容自动创建为标签。
addOnBlur.en-US: Whether the input text becomes a tag when the focus leaves the whole component.

allowDuplicates.zh-CN: 是否允许添加相同的标签。
allowDuplicates.en-US: Whether the same tag can be added more than once.

autoFocus.zh-CN: 挂载时是否自动聚焦输入框并激活组件，禁用时不生效。
autoFocus.en-US: Whether the input is focused and the component activated on mount; ignored when disabled.

aria-label.zh-CN: 输入框的可访问名称，落在输入框上，根节点不带。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the input. It is set on the input, not on the root.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 替换清除按钮中的图标，未设置时使用默认图标。
clearIcon.en-US: Replaces the icon in the clear button; the default icon is used when omitted.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用；禁用时输入框为原生 `disabled`，标签为静态文本。
disabled.en-US: Whether the component is disabled. The input becomes native `disabled` and the tags become static text.

draggable.en-US: Whether tags can be reordered by dragging.

expandRestTagsOnClick.zh-CN: 焦点进入组件（点击、Tab 或 `focus()`）后是否展开被 `maxTagCount` 折叠的标签；为 `false` 时始终保持折叠。
expandRestTagsOnClick.en-US: Whether the tags folded by `maxTagCount` expand once focus enters the component (click, Tab or `focus()`); when `false`, they stay folded.

inputValue.zh-CN: 当前输入框内容，配合 `onInputChange` 实现受控。
inputValue.en-US: Current input text. Pair it with `onInputChange` for a controlled input.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 内嵌标签，显示在输入框前；同时提供 `prefix` 时不显示它。显示时，没有 `aria-label`、`aria-labelledby` 的输入框以它命名。
insetLabel.en-US: Inset label shown before the input; it is hidden when `prefix` is also given. When shown, it names an input that has no `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: 内嵌标签容器的 `id`，供 `aria-labelledby` 引用；显示内嵌标签且未设置时，组件自动生成。
insetLabelId.en-US: `id` of the inset label container, for `aria-labelledby`; the component generates one when the inset label is shown and this is omitted.

max.zh-CN: 允许的标签最大数量，超出的部分不会成为标签，并触发 `onExceed`。
max.en-US: Maximum number of tags. The part beyond it does not become tags, and `onExceed` is called.

maxLength.zh-CN: 单个标签的最大长度，超出后不再接受输入，并触发 `onInputExceed`。
maxLength.en-US: Maximum length of one tag. Input beyond it is rejected, and `onInputExceed` is called.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 标签的最大展示数量，超出部分以 +N 形式展示；组件激活后展开，除非 `expandRestTagsOnClick` 为 `false`。
maxTagCount.en-US: Maximum number of tags shown; the rest are folded into +N. They expand while the component is active, unless `expandRestTagsOnClick` is `false`.

onAdd.zh-CN: 添加标签时触发，参数为实际新增的标签，超出 `max` 的部分不计入。
onAdd.en-US: Called when tags are added, with the tags actually added; those beyond `max` are excluded.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个组件时触发一次；焦点在组件内部移动不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called once when the focus leaves the whole component; moving focus inside it does not call it.

onChange.zh-CN: 标签变化时触发，参数为完整的标签数组。
onChange.en-US: Called when the tags change, with the whole list of tags.

onExceed.zh-CN: 添加后超过 `max` 时触发，参数为截断前的完整列表。
onExceed.en-US: Called when adding would exceed `max`, with the whole list before it is cut.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点从组件外进入时触发一次；焦点在输入框、标签、清除按钮之间移动不触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called once when the focus enters from outside; moving between the input, tags and clear button does not call it.

onInputChange.zh-CN: 输入框内容变化时触发，参数为新的输入文字与触发它的事件。事件可能是输入事件、KeyboardEvent（回车添加）、FocusEvent（`addOnBlur`）、MouseEvent（清除）或 CompositionEvent（输入法截断），读取专有字段前先按 `event.type` 收窄。
onInputChange.en-US: Called when the input text changes, with the new text and the event that caused it. The event may be an input event, a KeyboardEvent (Enter adds), a FocusEvent (addOnBlur), a MouseEvent (clear) or a CompositionEvent (IME truncation); narrow it by `event.type` before reading its own fields.

onInputExceed.zh-CN: 输入内容超过 `maxLength` 时触发，参数为被拒绝的输入内容。
onInputExceed.en-US: Called when the input text exceeds `maxLength`, with the rejected input text.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 输入框按键时在组件处理之后触发；在其中调用 `preventDefault` 不会阻止回车添加标签。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called on keydown in the input after the component has handled it; calling `preventDefault` there does not stop Enter from adding a tag.

onRemove.zh-CN: 移除标签时触发，参数为被移除的标签及其序号。
onRemove.en-US: Called when a tag is removed, with the removed tag and its index.

placeholder.zh-CN: 没有标签时输入框的占位文字。
placeholder.en-US: Placeholder of the input while there are no tags.

prefix.zh-CN: 输入框前缀，文字或图标会自动带上左右间隔；自定义节点的左右间隔为 0，可在节点中自行设置。
prefix.en-US: Prefix of the input; text or an icon gets side spacing automatically, while a custom node gets none and can set its own.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内 `focus()` 调用是否阻止浏览器滚动到新聚焦的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the `focus()` calls inside the component stop the browser from scrolling the focused element into view.

ref.zh-CN: 句柄，暴露 `focus()` 与 `blur()` 方法，不是根元素。
ref.en-US: Handle exposing the `focus()` and `blur()` methods; it is not the root element.

renderTagItem.zh-CN: 自定义标签渲染，返回的节点替换默认标签，组件会为每项加上 `key`。第三个参数 `onClose` 关闭该标签，可直接作为按钮的 `onClick`。
renderTagItem.en-US: Renders each tag with a custom node in place of the default tag; the component adds a `key` to each item. The third argument, `onClose`, removes that tag and can be passed directly as a button's `onClick`.

restTagsPopoverProps.zh-CN: +N 浮层的 Popover 属性，如 `position`、`trigger`，默认分别为 `top` 与 `hover`，具体见 [Popover·API 参考](/zh-CN/react/show/popover#API_参考)；不要传 `content`，它会替换剩余标签的列表。
restTagsPopoverProps.en-US: Popover props of the +N overlay, such as `position` and `trigger`, which default to `top` and `hover`, see [Popover API Reference](/en-US/react/show/popover#API%20Reference); do not pass `content`, it replaces the list of remaining tags.

separator.zh-CN: 批量输入时的分隔符，可传多个；传 `null` 不拆分。
separator.en-US: Separator(s) for adding several tags at once; `null` disables splitting.

showClear.zh-CN: 是否显示一键清除所有标签和输入内容的按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether to show the button that clears all tags and the input text.

showContentTooltip.zh-CN: 标签文字被截断时，hover 标签是否通过浮层显示全部内容；传对象时用 `type` 指定浮层类型（`tooltip` 或 `popover`），用 `opts` 透传给浮层的属性。
showContentTooltip.en-US: Whether hovering a truncated tag shows its full text in an overlay; an object sets the overlay `type` (`tooltip` or `popover`) and passes `opts` to it.

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 超过 `maxTagCount` 后，hover `+N` 时是否通过 Popover 显示剩余标签。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: Whether hovering `+N` shows the remaining tags in a Popover once `maxTagCount` is exceeded.

split.zh-CN: 自定义分隔符处理函数，参数为原始字符串与 `separator`，返回拆分后的字符串数组。
split.en-US: Custom split function that receives the raw string and `separator`, and returns the split strings.

suffix.zh-CN: 输入框后缀，文字或图标会自动带上左右间隔；自定义节点的左右间隔为 0，可在节点中自行设置。
suffix.en-US: Suffix of the input; text or an icon gets side spacing automatically, while a custom node gets none and can set its own.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，仅影响样式；为 `error` 时输入框带 `aria-invalid`。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which only affects styling; `error` also sets `aria-invalid` on the input.

value.zh-CN: 当前标签，配合 `onChange` 实现受控；`undefined` 时按非受控处理，`null` 表示受控且没有标签。
value.en-US: Current tags, pair it with `onChange` for a controlled list; `undefined` means uncontrolled, `null` means controlled with no tags.

blur.zh-CN: 移出焦点：使组件内持有焦点的元素失去焦点，并退出激活状态。
blur.en-US: Removes focus from the focused element inside the component and deactivates it.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦输入框并激活组件；禁用时不激活。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input and activates the component; the component is not activated when disabled.
